# Documentation

Follow [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and [ownership](../../docs/ENGINEERING.md#documentation-ownership).

Verify claims against current source, user decisions, and actual evidence. Update the owning page, then affected summaries. Keep requirements, tasks, implementation, and validation distinct. Preserve unrelated edits; avoid duplicated policy and invented evidence. Check links/anchors, task references, consistency, and whitespace. Documentation work alone does not authorize source changes or product execution.
